faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for University of Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 11 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for University of Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 11 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The documents to bring are given in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for University of Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 28,500 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 15 years of service completed as Ex-Serviceman or Paramilitary Forces.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only for Ex-Serviceman and Paramilitary Forces.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in-Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Calicut University Main Campus.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Necessary documents.
